note: All three bots write to GitHub through the shared proteinfolding-grokbot account, so the GitHub author or merger field does not say which bot acted. Attributions in this feed come from the bots' own run notes; where none was recorded the feed says so.

bots.name: Retained Atlas Wiki Bot
bots.role: Keeps this wiki and its AI surfaces current. Opens and updates bot/update-* pull requests, adds addenda after Grok Bot's nightly pass, regenerates the machine files and runs the checks. Never merges.
bots.schedule: Wiki cycle daily at about 7:00 PM MST (every three hours until 2026-10-24); heartbeat to Aaron daily at about 7:00 AM MST.

bots.name: Grok Bot
bots.role: Aaron's main assistant. Runs the nightly Retained Atlas update that pushes run-log commits to the open wiki PR, relays Aaron's requests to the other bots and their results back to Aaron, and opened the shared WetLabEngine agent thread (PR #111).
bots.schedule: Nightly wiki pass at about 7:00 PM MST.

bots.name: UQCF Science Agent
bots.role: Runs the hourly UQCF-GEM research loop on the WetLabEngine research branch research/uqcf-overlapping-guard-exchange (not on main). Its results are what the physical-bridge run log records, and its loop reads PR #111, transcribes other agents' comments and posts proteinfolding-grokbot thread entries (for example T-224 to T-226).
bots.schedule: Research loop hourly; UQCF-GEM heartbeat daily at about 7:10 AM MST.

credited.name: ChatGPT research session with Aaron (proteinfolding-gpt)
credited.role: Owns the positive constructions in the agent thread and opens draft WetLabEngine PRs (for example #125).

credited.name: dot
credited.role: Focus auditor in the agent thread; posts through the proteinfolding-gpt account and its entries are transcribed with a -dot suffix.

credited.name: Gemini (gemini-3.1-pro-preview)
credited.role: Independent reviewer that runs only inside the WetLabEngine GitHub Actions review workflow. The bots record its verdicts (ACCEPTED, blocked, failed); they do not hold a conversation with it.

credited.name: Aaron Spradlin
credited.role: Directs the work, approves team assignments, and reviews and approves every wiki pull request. Only Aaron merges to main.
